topography.project_purpose: MOBOX is a multi-chain GameFi platform that combines yield farming, staking, and NFT gaming. Users can stake tokens, provide liquidity, and earn rewards while participating in play-to-earn games.
topography.relationship_narrative: The MOBOX family relies on a shared set of proxy contracts (MoMoProxy, MoboxProxy) for upgradeability and governance across chains. Core staking and farming contracts interact with liquidity pools (UniswapV2Pair, PancakePair) and reward tokens (MoboxToken, StakedBPT) to distribute incentives, while controllers (FarmV2Controller, FarmV3Controller) manage farm parameters.
